title: Count Distinct Substrings (Suffix Trie)
summary: Count the different substrings of a word by inserting every suffix into a trie: each substring is a path from the root, and each new node is a substring seen for the first time.

anchors.label: Start with an empty trie and a count of zero
Start at the root for the next suffix
Does the current node have a child for this letter?
Create the child and count a new substring
Return the number of distinct substrings
